description:
T-Top Vibes is an authorized retailer of officially licensed automotive apparel, accessories, and Seat Cover Towels designed for enthusiasts who take pride in their vehicles. We offer premium products featuring Corvette, Bronco, Jeep, Mustang, Camaro, Chevrolet, Dodge, and other iconic automotive brands. Our mission is to provide high-quality automotive lifestyle products backed by outstanding customer service and FREE U.S. shipping.  

What makes us different:

 • Authorized retailer of officially licensed automotive merchandise.

 • Premium Seat Cover Towels that install in about 10 seconds. 

• Helps protect seats from sweat, dirt, spills, pet hair, sunscreen, and everyday messes. 

• Heavyweight cotton terry construction that is machine washable and reusable. 

• Veteran-owned small business focused on serving automotive enthusiasts. 

• Responsive support and long-term partnerships with our affiliates. 

 How affiliates can earn:

 • Earn 10% commission on every qualifying sale. 

• 30-day referral cookie on all purchases. 

• Your audience receives 10% OFF eligible Seat Cover Towels with your affiliate coupon. 

• Monthly commission payouts via Venmo after qualifying orders have been verified. 

How to promote us: Our products perform best through authentic, real-world content, including: 

• Vehicle walkthroughs 

• Product demonstrations 

• Beach and pool trips 

• Off-road adventures 

• Road trips 

• Car shows 

• Daily driving 

• Before-and-after installation videos 

• Family and pet travel 

Other information: We're looking for creators who genuinely love cars, trucks, SUVs, and the automotive lifestyle. Whether your audience is passionate about Corvettes, Broncos, Jeeps, Mustangs, Camaros, Chevrolet trucks, detailing, or outdoor adventures, we'd love to partner with you. 

We believe authentic content builds trust, and we're committed to building long-term relationships with creators who are excited to grow alongside T-Top Vibes.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed monthly and paid via Venmo after qualifying orders have been verified and are outside the applicable return period.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to the T-Top Vibes Affiliate Program!

We're excited to partner with automotive enthusiasts, creators, influencers, and publishers who share our passion for officially licensed automotive apparel and accessories.

By applying to or participating in the T-Top Vibes Affiliate Program ("Program"), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not participate in the Program.

1. Affiliate Approval

Participation in the Program is subject to approval by T-Top Vibes.

We reserve the right to approve, reject, suspend, or terminate any affiliate application or account at our sole discretion and at any time, with or without notice.

Reasons for rejection or termination may include, but are not limited to:

  • False or misleading information
  • Spam or unethical marketing
  • Trademark infringement
  • Fraudulent activity
  • Conduct that may harm the reputation of T-Top Vibes

2. Affiliate Links & Coupon Codes

Approved affiliates will receive a unique affiliate link. Some affiliates may also receive a unique coupon code.

Sales will be attributed based on the tracking methods established within our affiliate platform.

Affiliate links and coupon codes are intended solely for the approved affiliate's promotional use.

Affiliates may not:

  • Share unauthorized coupon codes
  • Create misleading promotions
  • Misrepresent discounts
  • Offer discounts not approved by T-Top Vibes

If both an affiliate link and coupon code are used on the same order, only one commission will be paid.

3. Commission Structure

Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their approved affiliate links or authorized coupon codes.

Commission rates are determined by the current affiliate program settings and may be updated at any time.

Commissions are calculated using the product subtotal only and do not include:

  • Shipping charges
  • Taxes
  • Gift cards
  • Other non-product fees

No commissions will be paid on:

  • Refunded orders
  • Cancelled orders
  • Chargebacks
  • Fraudulent transactions

4. Payment

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information within their Affiliate Dashboard.

Approved commissions will be paid according to the payment schedule established by T-Top Vibes.

T-Top Vibes reserves the right to review any transaction before issuing payment.

5. Marketing Guidelines

Affiliates may promote T-Top Vibes through websites, blogs, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, email newsletters (where legally permitted), and other approved marketing channels.

Affiliates agree NOT to:

  • Send spam
  • Use deceptive advertising
  • Make false product claims
  • Create fake reviews
  • Misrepresent prices or promotions
  • Impersonate T-Top Vibes
  • Violate platform rules or applicable laws

Affiliates are responsible for ensuring all marketing complies with applicable advertising regulations.

6. FTC Disclosure

Affiliates must comply with all applicable Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines and any other applicable advertising laws.

Whenever promoting T-Top Vibes products, affiliates must clearly disclose their affiliate relationship.

Examples include:

  • #Affiliate
  • #Ad
  • "I may earn a commission from qualifying purchases."

7. Brand & Intellectual Property

T-Top Vibes grants approved affiliates a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use approved logos, product images, and marketing materials solely for promoting T-Top Vibes.

Affiliates may not:

  • Modify logos
  • Alter branding
  • Create misleading advertisements
  • Imply sponsorship or endorsement beyond participation in this Program

All trademarks, logos, product images, graphics, and other intellectual property remain the exclusive property of T-Top Vibes.

8. Cookie Tracking

Affiliate referrals are tracked using cookies and other tracking technologies.

The current cookie duration is displayed within the Affiliate Dashboard.

If cookies are blocked, deleted, expire, or cannot be tracked for any reason, T-Top Vibes cannot guarantee commission credit.

9. Program Changes

T-Top Vibes reserves the right to modify:

  • Commission rates
  • Cookie duration
  • Payment schedules
  • Affiliate requirements
  • Marketing policies
  • These Terms & Conditions

Continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of any updates.

10. Termination

Either party may terminate participation in the Affiliate Program at any time.

Upon termination:

  • Affiliate links may be disabled
  • Coupon codes may be deactivated
  • Unpaid commissions for ineligible or fraudulent transactions may be forfeited

Affiliates may request account removal by contacting:

support@ttopvibes.com

11. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, T-Top Vibes shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from participation in the Affiliate Program.

Participation is at the affiliate's own risk.

12. Governing Law

These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted under the laws of the State of Utah, without regard to conflict of law principles.

Any disputes arising from the Affiliate Program shall be resolved in the appropriate state or federal courts located in Utah.
